rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent stepped mass across all four views, so it avoids the 'coherent in only one view' failure. However, for neighborhood living it is still mostly a compact stacked block with little evidence of a public court, notch, or active ground threshold responding to the verified access edge. The stepped silhouette is orderly rather than arbitrary, but the program contract asks for an active street edge and usable public void/terrace, which are only weakly implied. The mass therefore has acceptable hierarchy and repair integrity, but low void publicness and only partial program appropriateness. It resonates somewhat with stepped neighborhood references, yet not enough to hard-pass the access/public-space relation.
